native_integration: The existing Rust XGrammar compiler builds the bounded union; no external repository, library or subprocess is needed for inference.
Auto/unset tool_choice plus response_format permits tool calls or a bare JSON answer. Required/named choices retain the tool grammar; none retains the response-format grammar.
The first output token uses tool-branch versus other-token probability mass. Explicit tool-call bias is omitted for the union while repeat-call penalties remain.
The GLM native tool opener may end reasoning and is consumed by the union matcher. The branch-selection token uses host logits and cannot be selected by a speculative verify row.
Existing main model-specific sampling presets, runtime timing, scheduler lifecycle and CPU contracts remain in place.
A parser without tool-grammar support is rejected as HTTP400 for a union request, preserving Atlas strict response_format behavior instead of silently generating unconstrained output.
The schema byte limit is checked on EBNF cache hits as well as new compilations, so a prior unbounded compile cannot bypass it.
validation_scope: CPU grammar/API/scheduler tests; live two-turn probe supplied for subsequent GPU validation. No GPU claim is made by this port.
